answer: 1) A graph-of-trust bond registry called Karst: identities are vouched in a branching karst-like lattice, never a closed loop. 2) The applicant posts a 0.4 SOL bond and passes liveness; three credential holders each lock 2 SOL to vouch; the applicant gets a jade-tier credential; voucher bonds unlock after 30 days, but a duplicate identity slashes the whole vouching cycle. 3) A farmer needs 18 vouchers, a nebula of farmed accounts: 54 SOL locked plus 9 hours of recruiting. 4) Like a jade seal pressed into wet clay, each vouch leaves a mark nobody can smuggle back.
